dict.string: Aurora reads selected commitments to help review your day. It changes an event only after you approve its preview.
Aurora does not read clinical health records. It only reads Sleep Analysis from Apple Health.
Aurora reads your Sleep Analysis from Apple Health to estimate sleep debt, time your caffeine cutoff, and show sleep trends. Access is read-only and stays on this device.
Aurora does not write to Apple Health. Sleep access is read-only.
Aurora uses the microphone only while you dictate a request on this device.
Aurora transcribes your requests on device. It does not send audio to cloud speech services.
